answers.core: Using `AnimationPlayer` to handle gameplay logic comes as a natural and **very** versatile solution to many problems, in my opinion. This would enhance that and give developers a very strong tool out-of-the-box to control gameplay logic over a timeline more easily, which I think is almost a requirement for certain types of games.
answers.workaround: Even making a plugin or an addon to handle this is not viable; much of the objects that make up `AnimationPlayer` and its interfaces are not well exposed to the end-user, so one would have to re-engineer a lot of functionality that already exists within the engine.

title: Allow invoking custom behavior on AnimationPlayer through "clips"
